name: module
title: Radio module
summary: Radio or processor module body: a soldermasked board on gold LGA pads in up to eight rows (two a side), a ground array along the axes, up to 16 single pads, a nickel-silver shield can with rounded top edges and a printed antenna meander at the +y end; what a module lacks is parked at park_x and cut away.
provenance: Original work: the in-code module builder's construction (crates/solidcraft-integration/src/models/module.rs, retired with these files) made parametric in its rows, ground array, single pads and antenna meander, saved through SolidCraft's commands by `cargo test -p sparksmith-solidcraft --test author_parts -- --ignored` at the module form's typical values (an original synthetic 18 × 25 mm castellated module), LGA pads; the module generator gives every parameter its value. Outline, pad rows, pitch, can and ground array are the generator's (a module datasheet's mechanical drawing and land pattern, e.g. Espressif's public ESP32-S31-WROOM-3 datasheet v0.7 for its preset); pad thickness, can edge round and the antenna meander are estimated. No vendor drawing, CAD model or EDA library data copied.
